verses.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
verses.english: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
verses.explanation: A source of hope and resilience — Allah never places on anyone more than they can handle, reminding believers that every trial is within their capacity to endure.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
verses.english: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.explanation: One of the most comforting verses in the Quran — no matter how great one's sins, the door of repentance and Allah's mercy is always open.

verses.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
verses.english: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
verses.explanation: True inner peace comes not from wealth or status, but from the constant remembrance of Allah — a timeless remedy for anxiety and restlessness.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.english: For indeed, with hardship will be ease. Indeed, with hardship will be ease.
verses.explanation: Allah repeats this promise twice in the same surah for emphasis — ease is inseparable from hardship, and relief always follows difficulty.

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
verses.english: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
verses.explanation: Patience and prayer are prescribed as the believer's greatest tools in times of hardship, with a divine assurance that Allah stands with those who persevere.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
verses.english: And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a decreed extent.
verses.explanation: A powerful promise of tawakkul (trust in God) — whoever places full reliance on Allah will find Him fully sufficient, for Allah's plan always unfolds perfectly.

verses.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
verses.english: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
verses.explanation: A mutual promise between Allah and the believer — remembrance and gratitude are not just acts of worship, but a direct path to Allah's attention and blessings.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.english: And He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
verses.explanation: Allah's presence and awareness are boundless — this verse encourages sincerity in all actions, knowing that no deed goes unnoticed by the All-Seeing.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
verses.english: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
verses.explanation: One of the most comprehensive supplications in the Quran, balancing both worldly wellbeing and eternal salvation in a single, concise prayer.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are true believers.
verses.explanation: A rallying call for believers not to succumb to despair or weakness — true faith grants inner elevation and dignity regardless of outward circumstances.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.english: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.explanation: The opening of the Quran establishes Allah's defining attributes — absolute sovereignty paired with boundless mercy, setting the tone for the entire revelation.

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
verses.english: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
verses.explanation: Considered the greatest verse in the Quran, Ayat al-Kursi declares Allah's absolute, uninterrupted dominion over all of creation — a verse of immense protection and spiritual power.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
verses.english: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
verses.explanation: Repentance is not a one-time act but a continuous journey — Allah's love is drawn to those who keep returning to Him with sincerity and strive for purity.

verses.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
verses.english: Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor has He detested you.
verses.explanation: Revealed during a period of silence in revelation, this verse is a tender divine reassurance — Allah never abandons those He loves, even when His signs seem absent.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ ۞ وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب
verses.english: So when you have finished your duties, then stand up for worship. And to your Lord direct your longing.
verses.explanation: A guidance on continuous devotion — once worldly tasks are done, the believer immediately turns toward worship, keeping the heart perpetually oriented to Allah.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.
verses.explanation: From the story of Prophet Ya'qub — despair in Allah's relief is not the trait of a believer. Hope in Allah's mercy must be unwavering, no matter how bleak things appear.

verses.arabic: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ
verses.english: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, all that is of the matters requiring determination.
verses.explanation: The timeless fatherly wisdom of Luqman — prayer, moral responsibility, and patience form the foundation of a principled and determined Muslim life.

verses.arabic: سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
verses.english: Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.
verses.explanation: A concise yet profound divine promise — ease is not a possibility but a certainty. What follows difficulty is always relief, by Allah's guarantee.

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ
verses.english: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
verses.explanation: Diversity in race and tribe is a divine design for acquaintance, not superiority. True nobility before Allah is measured solely by taqwa (God-consciousness), not lineage.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
verses.english: My Lord, expand for me my breast (ease my task). And ease for me my task. And untie the knot from my tongue. That they may understand my speech.
verses.explanation: The dua of Prophet Musa before facing Pharaoh — a perfect supplication for anyone about to take on a daunting task, asking Allah for clarity of mind, ease, and effective speech.
